lines.en: label day126:
scene yumidesk1
We interrupt this broadcast to bring you breaking news.
lines.zh: 我们中断本次广播，为您插播一条突发新闻。

lines.en: Yumi is in the classroom today.
lines.zh: Yumi 今天来教室了。

lines.en: This is truly an event that will go on to shock the world.
lines.zh: 这真是足以震惊世界的大事件。

lines.en: Of course, such a rare occurrence doesn’t come without its setbacks, though.
lines.zh: 当然，这种罕见的现象也不是没有代价的。

lines.en: For example, Futaba isn’t even here yet and her seat has already been stolen.
lines.zh: 比如，Futaba 人还没来，她的座位就已经被占了。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like we have assigned seating in this classroom or anything like that, but it’s still clear that this is a targeted act on Yumi’s behalf.
lines.zh: 我是说，我们班又没有什么固定座位之类的，但很明显，这是 Yumi 有针对性的行为。

lines.en: To be honest, I’m surprised she even remembers where Futaba sits with how little she comes to class.
lines.zh: 说实话，Futaba 来上课的次数那么少，我都很惊讶她居然还记得 Futaba 坐哪儿。

lines.en: scene yumidesk2
: Hm? What do you want?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你想干嘛？

lines.en: : That’s...ummm...
: That's where I...normally sit...
lines.zh: : 那是我……平时坐的地方……

lines.en: : ...Okay? And?
lines.zh: : ……所以呢？然后呢？

lines.en: : Um...Would you be able to...
lines.zh: : 那个……你能不能……

lines.en: : Just fucking say it, fatass. The hell do you want?
lines.zh: : 有屁快放，肥猪。你他妈到底想干嘛？

lines.en: scene yumidesk3
: Can you...at least let me get my books out of the desk?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……至少让我把书从桌子里拿出来？

lines.en: : Depends. Anything in it for me?
lines.zh: : 看情况。有什么好处？

lines.en: : What...would you want?
lines.zh: : 你……想要什么？

lines.en: : Hmm...have any cash on ya? I’d probably be willing to sit somewhere else if you can spot me some lunch money.
lines.zh: : 嗯……身上有钱吗？要是你能借我点午饭钱，我也许愿意换个地方坐。

lines.en: scene yumidesk4
: Is there anything else you would want? I don’t really have enough money on me to buy lunch for both you and myself.
lines.zh: : 你还有别的想要的吗？我身上的钱不够给你和我自己都买一份午饭。

lines.en: : That’s fine. You’ve got enough food stored in you to go without lunch for a day or two. Maybe even a week, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你体内储存的粮食够你饿上一两天了。现在想想，搞不好够撑一周。

lines.en: Hearing that, I begin to make my way over to their side of the room and prepare myself to intervene if things escalate any further.
lines.zh: 听到这话，我开始朝她们那边走过去，准备好在事态进一步升级时出面干预。

lines.en: Technically, Yumi isn’t doing anything wrong other than just being a bitch, so I should wait to see if anything else actually happens.
lines.zh: 严格来说，Yumi 除了是个婊子之外并没做错什么，所以我该先看看还会不会真的出别的事。

lines.en: : But...I already skipped breakfast today and-
lines.zh: : 可是……我今天早饭就没吃，而且——

lines.en: : And what? You’re not thinking of eating any of us, are you?
lines.zh: : 而且什么？你该不会是想吃掉我们吧？

lines.en: : Lay a finger on me and I’ll fucking murder you.
lines.zh: : 敢碰我一根指头，我他妈就宰了你。

lines.en: scene yumidesk5
: I wouldn’t ever do something like that to you...or anyone. I just want my books...
lines.zh: : 我绝不会对你……或对任何人做那种事的。我只是想要我的书……

lines.en: : Yeah, I heard you the first time. Do I need to repeat my demands or are you going to fork over a few hundred yen?
lines.zh: : 行，我第一遍就听见了。要我再说一遍我的条件，还是你乖乖掏出几百日元？

lines.en: : How about I buy you lunch instead, Yumi? Will that work?
lines.zh: : 要不我请你吃午饭吧，Yumi？这样行吗？

lines.en: scene yumidesk6
I decide to step in before I become an accomplice to extortion, which I’m pretty sure is against[school] policy.
lines.zh: 我决定在成为敲诈勒索的共犯之前出手干预，我敢肯定那是违反[school]规定的。

lines.en: I haven’t even bothered trying to read the handbook, though. So who even knows?
lines.zh: 不过我连手册都懒得翻。所以谁知道呢。

lines.en: : The fuck are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : I know you’re not here often, but you are aware this is my classroom, correct?
lines.zh: : 我知道你不常来，但你应该知道这是我的教室吧？

lines.en: : I guess. And you are aware that I can do whatever the fuck I want, correct?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。那你也知道我想他妈干什么就干什么吧？

lines.en: : That’s true outside of[school] grounds, but I’m pretty sure I’m obligated to step in during situations like this.
lines.zh: : 在校外是这样，不过我觉得这种情况下我有义务出面。

lines.en: : Um...Sensei...you don’t have to-
lines.zh: : 那个……Sensei……你不用——

lines.en: : It’s okay, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Futaba。

lines.en: : I think I've learned how to deal with her by now.
lines.zh: : 我想我现在已经学会怎么对付她了。

lines.en: scene yumidesk7
: The fuck do you mean you've learned how to deal with me? Why are you makin’ it sound like some fuckin’ chore?
lines.zh: : 你他妈说你学会怎么对付我了是什么意思？干嘛说得好像是什么该死的苦差事？

lines.en: : Last I remember, you were the one stalking me. Isn’t that right, asshole?
lines.zh: : 我记得最后一次，是你在跟踪我吧？对不对，混蛋？

lines.en: scene yumidesk8
: S-Stalking?...Is that...true?
lines.zh: : 跟、跟踪？……那是……真的吗？

lines.en: scene yumidesk9
: Fuck yeah it’s true. And that’s just the beginning of it.
lines.zh: : 废话，当然是真的。而这还只是个开始。

lines.en: : Can’t even imagine what he’s been doing to the rest of-
lines.zh: : 我都想象不出他还对其他人做过——

lines.en: : Okay, calm down. I’m not stalking anyone.
lines.zh: : 好了，冷静点。我没有跟踪任何人。

lines.en: : I’ve just been trying to help Yumi out from time to time.
lines.zh: : 我只是时不时想帮 Yumi 一把而已。

lines.en: scene yumidesk8
: Uhh, dipshit, I’ve been telling you for pretty much forever that the best way to ‘help me out’ is by just leaving me the fuck alone.
lines.zh: : 呃，蠢货，我他妈从很久以前就跟你说了，想「帮我」最好的办法就是离我远点。

lines.en: : If you wanna pay for my lunch, cool, but I’m not givin’ up the fuckin’ desk. I was here first. I know my rights.
lines.zh: : 你要是想请我吃午饭，行，但桌子我他妈不让。我先来的。我知道我的权利。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and direct my attention to Futaba.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，把注意力转向 Futaba。

lines.en: : She does have a point, Futaba. You’re all technically allowed to sit wherever you want. And Yumi was here first today.
lines.zh: : 她说得也有道理，Futaba。严格来说你们想坐哪儿都行。而且今天是 Yumi 先来的。

lines.en: scene yumidesk10
: Wait...are you actually takin’ my side? The fuck is goin’ on here?
lines.zh: : 等等……你真站我这边？这他妈是什么情况？

lines.en: : I’m not taking anyone’s side. I’m just saying you’re allowed to sit wherever you want.
lines.zh: : 我没站任何人那边。我只是说你想坐哪儿都行。

lines.en: : But, if at all possible, do you think you’d be able to reach deep inside that shell of a heart you have and find the kindness to give Futaba her books?
lines.zh: : 不过，如果可以的话，你觉得你能不能往你那颗贝壳一样的心里深处掏一掏，找出一点善意，把书还给 Futaba？

lines.en: : She’s not bothering you.
lines.zh: : 她又没惹你。

lines.en: : I don’t know, man. Feels pretty bothersome to have to get off the desk just so some fatass can read books about knights and giant lizards and shit.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，老兄。为了某个肥猪能看什么骑士和巨蜥之类的书，害我还得从桌子上下来，感觉挺烦的。

lines.en: scene yumidesk11
: They’re...dragons...not lizards.
lines.zh: : 那是……龙……不是蜥蜴。

lines.en: : I don’t give a fuck what they are. They’re weird as shit and you’re weird for reading them.
lines.zh: : 我才他妈不管那是什么。那玩意儿怪得要死，看那些书的你也怪。

lines.en: : Yumi, I know doing this doesn’t really work on you, but I’m going to have to give you detention if you insult Futaba again.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我知道这招对你没用，但你要是再侮辱 Futaba，我就只能让你留堂了。

lines.en: scene yumidesk12
: Are you now?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: Yumi hits me with an ice-cold gaze that would be more than enough to freeze the heart of anyone not used to her.
lines.zh: Yumi 用冰冷的眼神盯着我，那眼神足以冻僵任何不习惯她的人的心。

lines.en: But, seeing as I’ve legitimately made out with her without any consequences, I’m beginning to think she’s more bark than bite.
lines.zh: 不过，考虑到我实打实地跟她接过吻却没有任何后果，我开始觉得她多半只是嘴上凶。

lines.en: : I am. In fact, you’re banned from cursing for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 是的。而且，你今天剩下的时间禁止说脏话。

lines.en: scene yumidesk13
: Suck my dick you fucking ass-weasel!
lines.zh: : 去舔我的鸡巴吧，你个操蛋的屁眼黄鼠狼！

lines.en: : Okay, first off, where do you get these insults?
lines.zh: : 好，首先，你这些骂人的词都是从哪儿学来的？

lines.en: : Second, you have detention now. You’re staying after class today.
lines.zh: : 其次，你现在被留堂了。今天放学后留下。

lines.en: : I ain’t doin’ shit! I’ll leave this fuckin’ place right now!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不干呢！我现在就离开这鬼地方！

lines.en: scene yumidesk15
: Umm, Sensei? I’m sorry for causing so much trouble. If I knew this was going to happen, I wouldn’t have ever asked for my books in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那个，Sensei？对不起，我惹了这么多麻烦。要是早知道会变成这样，我一开始就不会开口要我的书了。

lines.en: : Don’t blame yourself just because Yumi has self-control issues, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 别因为 Yumi 有自控力问题就怪自己，Futaba。

lines.en: : I have self-control issues? Oh, that’s real fuckin’ rich.
lines.zh: : 我有自控力问题？哦，这话可真他妈好笑。

lines.en: : Bravo to you, dude. Completely ignoring your own problems and just pawnin’ all of your bullshit off on me. Thanks a lot for that.
lines.zh: : 说得好啊，老兄。对自己的问题视而不见，把你那一堆狗屁全赖到我头上。真是多谢你了。

lines.en: scene yumidesk16
: Um...what does she mean by that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那个……她那是什么意思，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah, Sensei. Go on and tell her and see if I’m still the bad guy.
lines.zh: : 对啊，Sensei。说给她听啊，看看到底谁才是坏人。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Futaba. Yumi’s talking about something that happened between the two of us outside of[school].
lines.zh: : 别在意，Futaba。Yumi 说的是我们俩在[school]之外发生的事。

lines.en: : Outside of[school]?...
lines.zh: : [school]之外？……

lines.en: : It doesn’t concern you. But, Yumi-
lines.zh: : 跟你无关。不过，Yumi——

lines.en: : What now? Gonna fuckin’ suspend me instead?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？要改成停我的课吗？

lines.en: : No. But I think the two of us need to have another talk.
lines.zh: : 不。但我觉得我们俩得再谈一次。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I think the two of you can both go fuck yourselves.
lines.zh: : 行啊，我还觉得你们俩都该去操自己呢。

lines.en: : I’m outta here.
lines.zh: : 我走了。

lines.en: : Peace.
lines.zh: : 拜拜。

lines.en: scene yumidesk17
Yumi quickly hops off of the desk and makes her way out of the classroom, leaving Futaba and me in the dust.
lines.zh: Yumi 迅速从桌上跳下来，走出教室，把 Futaba 和我晾在了原地。

lines.en: : I’m...a little confused...about what that was all about...
lines.zh: : 我……有点搞不清楚……刚才到底是怎么回事……

lines.en: I’m not. I was beginning to think that Yumi had gotten over that...occurrence from a while ago, but it’s clear to me now that this is most certainly not the case.
lines.zh: 我倒是很清楚。我本以为 Yumi 已经放下了前阵子那件……事，但现在我清楚了，显然根本不是这么回事。

lines.en: I’ll have to talk to her about that soon...
lines.zh: 我得尽快找她谈谈……

lines.en: But for now, I’ve got to do everything I can to revert the situation back to normal.
lines.zh: 不过现在，我得尽我所能把局面拉回正轨。

lines.en: I clear my throat and prepare to drag Futaba back to “reality.”
lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，准备把 Futaba 拉回「现实」。

lines.en: : Well, on the bright side-
lines.zh: : 那么，往好处想——

lines.en: : At least you got your desk back.
lines.zh: : 至少你把座位拿回来了。

lines.en: scene black
